failures.name: dsa::object::adv_probe::dsa_method_init_failure_runs_partial_cleanup
failures.observed_before: thread 'dsa::object::adv_probe::dsa_method_init_failure_runs_partial_cleanup' panicked at src/dsa/object.rs:1154:9: assertion `left == right` failed: the partial cleanup must release the context block and every seam-visible member; left: 3; right: 2
failures.cause: The probe counted every CRYPTO_free in the measurement window. The authority's failing method init also raises an error site; formatting and storing that entry allocates and releases a transient 1-byte block at the (NULL, 0) coordinate. The window therefore contained three releases: the 200-byte Dsa block, the 56-byte seam-visible lock, and the transient error-queue block. Instrumented events confirmed the sizes (200, 56, 1) before this was concluded.
failures.disposition: PROBE_ASSERTION_CORRECTED. No production code changed. The probe now records the context and its lock by address while the object is live (fail_init reads (*dsa).lock) and asserts that each is released exactly once; adv_alloc::assert_no_double_free() remains. The window-wide total was removed because it never described an ownership requirement.
failures.result_line: test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 2097 filtered out
